## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector leadership (Energy and Utilities positive while Tech and Consumer Disc. lag) and major divergences across large caps (MSFT, INTC, PLTR, ADBE showing 1W/1M mismatch), supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +11.20%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing pockets of strength: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging overall: GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND. Industrials soft despite outliers: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors across Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION, MNST (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in travel/defense and select tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged (≥3 large caps with 1W ≠ 1M): MSFT, INTC, PLTR, ADBE — watch for trend breaks; suppress strong directional bets.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with notable dispersion: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND versus MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology: 9/24 positive — internal rotation, watch leadership concentration.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials marginally positive but mixed: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.70% | 1M: +0.57%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Financials: 12/20 positive — mild internal strength; style: value/cyclical not dominant enough to shift regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare showing constructive internals: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%) ABOVE TREND, but LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND and SYK (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 10/17 positive — defensive tone but mixed signals from headline movers.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to Energy and Utilities names showing above-trend strength (MPC, VLO, VST) and monitor Financials for confirmation (JPM). Reduce exposure to weak, high-volatility tech laggards showing trend exhaustion (MSFT CORRECTION, ADBE CORRECTION, PLTR CORRECTION). Given NEUTRAL regime and major divergences, prioritize tactical trades and wait for broader confirmation before expanding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND — momentum and sector confirmation. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION, PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION, SYK (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (Sector breadth: 8/10 positive) and Utilities (Sector breadth: 8/10 positive) for continued leadership. BEARISH: Technology (Sector breadth: 9/24 positive) and Consumer Discretionary (Sector breadth: 3/14 positive) for downside risk and rotation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND — watch near prior resistance for continuation. AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for follow-through vs legal headline risk. JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND — watch for breakout to confirm Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
D (+85): NextEra‑Dominion merger cleared shareholder votes; price action in Utilities confirms sector strength. UNH (+55): Earnings beat and cost controls; UNH (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with short‑term lift. TSLA (+55): Robotaxi/Cybercab headlines; TSLA (1W: +1.53% | 1M: +10.81%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming momentum.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AAPL (-55): New UK/Europe lawsuit headlines; AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND — bearish sentiment diverging from price (distribution risk). WMT (-55): DOJ beef‑price probe expansion; WMT (1W: +3.93% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY — short‑term bounce despite negative headlines. SYK (+60 bullish headline) vs SYK (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline but price not confirming, notable divergence.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style (style mixed / no clear leadership). NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND and Energy/Utilities names (MPC, VST) showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergences across large caps (MSFT, INTC, PLTR, ADBE) and headline dispersion (AAPL, SYK) — monitor for trend confirmation before expanding exposure.
